data_description.verbrauch_zeitraeume: Three sensors for consumption, with a pellet price three more for the costs.
data_description.prognose: Learns from the history how much your house burns at which outside temperature and tells how long the store lasts. Up to six sensors.
data_description.wetter: Leave empty if you do not want to use a forecast. The prognosis then uses the long-term temperature average.

puffer.title: Buffer tank
puffer.description: How many litres does your buffer tank hold? The integration uses it to calculate how much heat is stored, and the pellet prognosis assigns consumption to the right day. With PufferFlex it reads the volume from the system - then you can leave 0. An entered value takes precedence.

fub_names.title: Confirm function block names
fub_names.description: If you renamed a function block (FUB) on your heating system's controller, enter the actual name here. The fields are pre-filled with the ETA default names.

data.twin: FUB name: pellet unit of the SH TWIN (Twin)
data.pufferflex: FUB name: buffer tank (default PufferFlex, older systems: Puffer)
data.fwm: FUB name: fresh water / hot water module (FWM or WW)
data.hk: FUB name: heating circuit 1 (HK or HK1)

reconfigure.description: For example when the heating system got a new address on your home network. Components, permissions and all other settings are changed under **Configure**.

switch_warning.title: Switching writes to your heating system
switch_warning.description:
You enabled switches. From now on Home Assistant can not only read your heating system, but also switch the boiler and the heating circuits off and on.

Please be aware:
- Switching off a heating circuit or the boiler in winter can let rooms cool down. Frost protection remains the responsibility of the heating system, not of Home Assistant.
- Anyone with access to your Home Assistant can operate these switches.
- Switches only appear where your heating system explicitly reports the variable as writable.

You can turn this off again at any time under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the ETA heating system. Check the IP address and make sure the web services are enabled on the boiler.

abort.already_configured: This ETA heating system (IP address + port) is already configured.

component_not_found.title: Component "{component}" not found
component_not_found.description:
The menu of your ETA heating system contains no values for the component "{component}". Its function block is probably named differently on your controller (expected roles: {fub_names}).

Open **Settings -> Devices & Services -> ETA Web-Services -> Configure** and enter the actual name, or untick the component if your system does not have it.
